notes: Kit can now tell us when one step inside a nightly dream fails while the rest of the night carries on. Until now a cycle that lost a step still reported success, so the only person who could see it was you, on your own health page. Your Kit will ask you about this the first time it starts, and it sends nothing until you say yes.

What it sends is three things per step and nothing else: which step, whether it failed or simply produced nothing, and the name of the error's type. No error message, and no free text of any kind, leaves your Mac for this.
Declining changes nothing for you. Your health page shows you all of it on your own machine either way, and always will.
